text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Boy howdy—you struck gold! And ya<n>looked so cool
runnin' the controls!
choice_data_list: It was a piece of cake!
It was a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? You mean there's cake in<n>there too?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, since you're such a pro at this,<n>next time be
sure to grab some cake<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You made today really special, so<n>thank ya! I won't
ever forget it!
